Four Indians killed in Ukraine ship attack; Ukraine reshuffles cabinet

Four Indian nationals were killed and one critically injured in an attack on a ship departing Ukraine's Odesa port on July 19. The vessel, MV GOLDEN LEO, had 17 crew members, including five Indians. In separate developments, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy initiated a cabinet reshuffle, leading to the resignation of Prime Minister Yulia Svyrydenko and the departure of Defense Minister Oleksandr Fedorov. Ukraine also launched approximately 400 drones targeting Moscow, while Russia conducted missile strikes.
